# Source-native unit and subject binding — ready for review

Completed macro_numeric_source_native_unit_binding_v2, resuming the prior nine-record partial without modifying its inputs or sealed checkpoints. Implemented a separate offline adapter, original parser/formula reproductions, guarded calculations and the actual source-asof consumer path. Design14.2–14.4, R05/R14.

Six Census versions produce eight subject/period-bound evidence cells. Two business_sales versions originally carried inventory0.8%; the original footer regex reproduces that value and its explicit Inventories label. The adapter preserves the original event/actual while exposing inventory0.8% and sales0.3% as separate components. Retail comparisons explicitly use the previous month. Housing compares August with revised July: its level is a seasonally adjusted annual rate, but the comparison is monthly, not annual. Other seasonal definitions are not inferred.

Recovered original BLS filtering/sorting/formula AST statements reproduce a calculation even when monthly observations are missing or duplicated. The separate guard requires matching series/transform, unique finite positive monthly levels, calendar adjacency across year boundaries, sufficient history and fixed50-digit precision. Original raw levels are unavailable for the two actual BLS records, so they remain unresolved; synthetic correctness does not backfill real data. The StatCan value reproduces0.3%, but comparison/seasonality remains unresolved. No original raw API/RSS binding, issuer certification, prior vintage or activation is invented.

Reused source-asof gates and exact parent/content/evidence hashes across8 cutoffs,168 currency rows and544 pair views. Nineteen reconstructed cell/event/cutoff rows are carried through the consumer. Original numeric events remain unchanged; runtime cells are empty and no forecast features, surprises or fits were admitted. This is retrospective retained-summary evidence, not proof of historical deployment. GPT/advisor comparisons and all deferred external actions remain deferred.

35 local and35 relocated tests passed;7 replay outputs match byte-for-byte. Tests cover actual subject/unit bindings, original formula defects, missing/duplicate months, invalid denominators, year rollover, contradictory summaries/footers, consumer no-fallback, identity drift/corruption, unsupported actions, false completion and crash/resume. The initial development probe abstained on two Census grouped-money amounts; that source/report is preserved, and the final parser handles the actual grouped amounts. No failed test was suppressed. Same-implementer final inspection completed; independent review unperformed. Per NEXT mode, publish ready_for_review and return.

Unresolved source evidence: two BLS original level tables; StatCan comparison/seasonality; original API/RSS receipts, original extraction clocks, issuer binding and activation. These are explicit data qualifications, not unimplemented software hidden as completed. Next is review_macro_unit_binding_checkpoint_v2. After acceptance, macro_numeric_reference_and_extraction_provenance_binding_v2 addresses the remaining ABS period and two BLS extraction-provenance records without manufacturing readiness.

# WP6 typed numeric source-asof state

Thirty-one numeric content records now feed typed event/currency states and544
shared pair views across eight cutoffs. Numeric material identity includes source
content, so equal displayed text cannot hide different numeric values. Both source
receipt clocks gate version resolution; the newest selected numeric version must
then have coherent numeric readiness at the cutoff. Missing/future/ambiguous
numeric clocks abstain instead of falling back to older values. Delayed readiness
of an older source version cannot replace a newer source version.

154 event-cutoff rows are ready under retained clock claims and14 are blocked by
missing numeric clocks;190 typed cell/event-cutoff rows are retained. These repeat
events across time and are not independent statistical support. Actual, reported
prior, revised/unrevised prior and revision remain separate decimal values. No
cross-series/currency arithmetic or numeric surprise is computed. Nine component
references are missing/unresolved; heterogeneous components never inherit the
headline period. Original prior vintage and independent extraction readiness are
not certified; all numeric-fact/forecast admission gates remain closed.

13 local and13 relocated tests pass; five payloads reproduce exactly. Tests cover
future source/envelope perturbations, missing/future/conflicting numeric clocks,
same-text numeric material conflicts, no fallback, delayed old-version readiness,
component dates/priors, zero presence, shared pair identities, pins and crash resume.
No collector/DB actions, model fits, outcomes or paid/GPT calls. Same-implementer
review only; independent review remains unperformed.
